meta.note: Seats won are the seats up in May; comp is the whole council after May (seats not up included). pc: chance of each control outcome. rg: seats won, 10th to 90th percentile. Great Yarmouth First (stood for the county as GYF (Restore)) is counted as Restore Britain (RES).
meta.sw: sw: per party [uniform swing in points needed for a majority, swing needed to be largest party], from the projection; negative = it has it now and keeps it until a swing of that size against it; -99 = keeps it beyond -15; councils needing more than +10 omitted.
